THE WORK THAT CONNECTS US

Care is a skill.
So is follow-through.

The principles that matter in a courier business: useful conversations, attention to details and a thoughtful approach to every package.

Communicate clearly

Make the next step easy to understand, whether you are speaking with a customer or coordinating a shipment.

Notice the details

Treat parcel information, preparation and handling with the attention they deserve.

Work together

Help people stay connected across the many handoffs of a shipment journey.

    Tell us about yourself

A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Are you hiring right now?+

No verified vacancies have been supplied for publication. Please enquire with the company directly about current opportunities.

Can I submit a CV on this website?+

This website does not provide an application upload or recruitment backend. Contact the team to confirm a vacancy and an appropriate application channel.

Which locations should I ask about?+

The company lists offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Delhi and Bengaluru. An office listing does not indicate that a job opening is available there.
